title: An Octopus Arm Can Act on Its Own, Even After It's Cut Off

scenes.text: Cut off an octopus arm and it still works.
An octopus has about 130 million neurons, and most are in its arms, not its brain.
So each arm can make its own decisions.
Researchers found a severed arm still grabs food and passes it toward where the mouth would be.
Even chilled for an hour, the arms still reacted when touched.
An octopus doesn't just have eight arms. It has eight small brains.

description:
Cut off an octopus arm and it still works.
An octopus has about 130 million neurons, and most sit in the arms. Research shows severed arms still react to touch and move food toward a phantom mouth.
If your arms had minds of their own, what would they do? Comment below.
